statement.p: A square matrix A is called half-magic if the sum of the numbers in each row and column is the same. The common sum in each row and column is denoted by s(A) and is called the magic sum of the matrix A. Let V be the vector space of 2\times 2 half-magic squares.
(a) Find an ordered basis B for V.
(b) Find the coordinate vector [M]_B of M=\left[\begin{array}{cc} -2 \amp 1\cr 1 \amp -2 \end{array}\right] in your chosen ordered basis B.
